objective: Build the double of the holed lattice torus T(3a Z^2) along a hexagonal hole (genus 2, six degree-8 vertices), choose its Kasteleyn sign class so the handle loops are flat, prove that developing one frame over the surface cut along six disjoint paths from a point z to the degree-8 faces gives an assignment with no violated line and exactly one over-agreeing face (an antivortex), and embed one-sided Sperner with the reversed boundary so that over-agreeing faces sit exactly in clockwise fully labelled triangles and violated lines in counterclockwise ones; conclude that finding an over-agreeing face is PPADS^dt-complete and that the two-sided problem is PPAD^dt-complete. Check every step by computation with controls.
status: Proved 2026-11-07: on the genus-2 double of a holed lattice torus (six degree-8 vertices, Kasteleyn signs) the frames turn by +1 at the degree-8 faces, exactly one sign class makes the handles flat, and the developed state has no violated line and one over-agreeing face (an antivortex); with FLAT-STATES-B's Sperner map mirrored, over-agreeing faces sit exactly in clockwise fully labelled triangles, so finding an over-agreeing face is PPADS^dt-complete and the two-sided problem PPAD^dt-complete, while the knot's lines are satisfiable.
title: The genus-2 antivortex: a mirrored Sperner embedding
